description: January 21 birthday meaning: Capricorn or Aquarius cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, January 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 21 birthday
paragraphs: Aquarius season usually begins by January 21, with the Sun at the very first degree of Uranus's fixed air sign. Still, someone born in the early hours of some years may have a late Capricorn Sun, so checking the exact time is worthwhile. Twenty-one reduces to 3, adding sociability and expressive flair to an inventive, independent outlook.

By noon UTC on January 21, the Sun has normally reached roughly 0° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the first of three. Around January 19 to January 21 the Sun moves from Capricorn into Aquarius, and people born near that border often feel pulled between tradition and reinvention. The exact crossing shifts from year to year, so your Sun sign depends on the year, the time and the place of birth; a calculated chart is the only firm answer. The blend is frequently described as a practical reformer: someone with Capricorn's patience and respect for structure who also carries Aquarius' independent, future-facing streak, wanting to change the system and to do it properly.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 21 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 21 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 21 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 21 is the 21st day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 29 days after this birthday.

January 21 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 1 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. January 21 is also the birthday of IShowSpeed (2005), Paul Allen (1953) and Plácido Domingo (1941).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 21?
faq.answer: January 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Aquarius. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 21 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 21?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 21 in 1 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 21?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 21 birthday are IShowSpeed (2005), Paul Allen (1953) and Plácido Domingo (1941). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
